Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-29-batch-ae/2026-10-29-batch-ae.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

source.operator_quote: Mb-53 needs wiring / definitely for all recommended. Add to the queue to ensure completiion and ensure compliance / Mb-56 - our current building footprint data isnt great - this is just a disclosure - for the renovation scenario - we need a user input

decisions.question: MB-53: street name into the lot vector
decisions.recommendation: Wire `parcels.primary_frontage_street_name` into the resolve_bylaws lot vector so `abuts_named_street` units decide. Rule text: The lot's frontage street name is a Layer 2 lot fact; clauses that name a street are evaluated from it.

decisions.question: MB-54: neighbour data (parcel_abutments) for front-yard averaging
decisions.recommendation: Wire parcel_abutments into Layer 2 and the max build as the FS-SB1/FS-SB2 neighbour front-setback input (one shared function) plus the abutting tokens; its costing use is separate. Rule text: Front-yard averaging and the abutting-building clauses read the neighbours from parcel_abutments through the FS-SB1/FS-SB2 chain.
decisions.operator_quote: definitely for all recommended. Add to the queue to ensure completiion and ensure compliance

decisions.question: MB-55: overlays
decisions.recommendation: Building setback overlay (15,296 lots) and the holding (H) symbol (105 lots) are wired into Layer 2 and the max build; policy area (29,757) and parking zone (73,778) feed the parking lot checks (MR-Q7); rooming house overlay (109,743) and the irregular-lot flag (127,115, our own) are disclosures. Rule text: By-law overlays that change the building (building setback overlay, holding symbol) are applied in Layer 2 and the max build; parking overlays feed the parking lot checks; use-only overlays and the irregular-lot flag are disclosed.
decisions.operator_quote: definitely for all recommended. Add to the queue to ensure completiion and ensure compliance

decisions.question: MB-56: lawfully existing status
decisions.recommendation: Not derived from building footprints (not reliable enough). On ordinary lots: a disclosure that the existing-building allowance may apply and is not evaluated. In the renovation scenario: a user input ("is the existing building lawful?") that the model applies. Rule text: Lawfully existing status is never inferred from footprint data; it is disclosed on ordinary lots and taken from a user input in the renovation scenario.
